code_review.project_type: web application — Dash SPA implementing an AI-assisted software-planning pipeline

existing_self_description.text: AI-assisted software project planning — from idea to executable coding phases.

architecture.summary: Spec4 is a Dash single-page app whose UI (layouts/, callbacks/) drives a pipeline of seven specialized LLM agents — CodeScanner, Brainstormer, Agentifier, Designer, StackAdvisor, Phaser, Deployer. Six live under src/spec4/agents/ (FeatureSpeccer is not a top-level agent but Brainstormer's internal spec-drafting step); Agentifier is its own multi-stage sub-pipeline (Scout → Linker → Composer → Tier Analyst → Spec Drafter → cross-cutting/priority passes) under src/spec4/agentifier/, guided by a markdown pattern catalog.
architecture.pattern: pipeline (multi-agent orchestration) within a layered Dash app

ui_summary.styling: Dash Mantine Components (dmc) primitives with custom CSS (src/spec4/assets/v3.css) and Google Fonts. Green #39FF14 is the Mantine theme primary and only accent color, set once at the theme level (D-LR2: no component sets a color locally). A 'mono' CSS class marks paths, file names, model names, and figures throughout the UI.

test_coverage.coverage_summary: tests/ (including tests/agentifier/ and tests/integration/) contains layout/callback contract tests: test_callback_co_presence.py enumerates every screen's component ids; test_cost_summary.py, test_agent_llm_selection.py, and test_code_scanner_progress.py assert relative ordering/id sequences in the chat frame; test_round_tree.py, test_agent_rows.py, test_root_routing.py, and test_agent_button_state.py cover the project-view surfaces including the Continue state. A .coverage file (pytest-cov output) is present at the repo root.

incomplete_or_dead_code: a2a_sdk appears only in pyproject.toml's [[tool.mypy.overrides]] ignore-list, not in declared dependencies — suggesting optional or in-progress use of the Agent2Agent SDK not yet a committed dependency.
dash-iconify is a declared dependency but is not used by the reworked screens; emoji were removed from the UI without icon replacements.

change_risks.risk: LITELLM_LOG must be set and litellm imported before spec4.callbacks imports, which must come after app is constructed; reordering would silently re-enable litellm's noisy AWS/Bedrock warnings or break callback registration
change_risks.mitigation_hint: preserve current import order; the E402/E501 ruff suppressions on this file are intentional, not an oversight

change_risks.risk: every Input of a registered callback must exist in the rendered layout when it fires; test_callback_co_presence.py enumerates each screen's ids
change_risks.mitigation_hint: keep existing ids; when a control is deliberately removed, remove its callback and its test entries in the same change

change_risks.risk: test_cost_summary.py, test_agent_llm_selection.py, and test_code_scanner_progress.py pin relative orderings
change_risks.mitigation_hint: run uv run pytest after every layout change

change_risks.area: Clientside callback DOM selectors in app.py
change_risks.risk: the scroll-to-latest callback queries .chat-bubble-user inside #chat-scroll-area; progress/elapsed tickers target #chat-progress-container and #chat-elapsed; the mock viewer targets #mock-fullscreen-btn
change_risks.mitigation_hint: restyles must keep those class names/ids or update the JS in the same change

change_risks.risk: all state lives in two browser dcc.Stores (session in sessionStorage, prefs in localStorage); there is no server-side session
change_risks.mitigation_hint: new components must read via callback State, not module globals

change_risks.risk: usage.json is deliberately excluded from the artifact dependency graph
change_risks.mitigation_hint: never add it to _STALE_DEPENDENCIES or _PIPELINE_ARTIFACT_ORDER; its tree status is presence-only

change_risks.risk: the Artifact View reads files only from _round_tree.ROUND_ARTIFACTS resolved under project_manager.get_version_dir, rejecting anything else before touching the filesystem
change_risks.mitigation_hint: any new file-reading surface must use the same resolver

other_notes: Directory listing was truncated (131 additional files not shown), so this review cannot claim completeness over remaining layouts/, callbacks/, or agentifier/patterns/ contents.
spec4-usage = spec4.usage_report:main is a secondary CLI script declared in pyproject.toml, distinct from the primary spec4 entrypoint.
A separate Makefile.publish exists alongside the main Makefile, likely a PyPI release workflow (contents not sampled).
mystuff/prompts.txt is a developer scratch file, not part of the shipped application.
.python-version file present, pinning the local Python toolchain version.
BWS4-logos/ holds brand assets for the 'Built With Spec4' companion showcase site (bw.spec4.ai) referenced in the README; not part of this app's runtime.
The project is distributed via PyPI (uv tool install spec4); no Dockerfile, docker-compose, Kubernetes manifests, or IaC files are present, so no deployment block applies.
Provider API keys and Tavily/Exa web-search keys are entered via the setup wizard and held only in browser dcc.Stores — there are no corresponding server-side env vars.

Coding conventions observed but not mappable to a coding_style schema key: design decisions are recorded as numbered comments (D-XX, e.g. D-LR1, D-PM1, D-AR1) at the point of implementation; layout helpers in _shared.py, _round_tree.py, and _round_cost.py are reused, never duplicated; agent order is defined once in app_constants.AGENT_KEYS and every agent-ordered table is asserted against it; status (artifact presence/staleness, agent action, cost) is recomputed from disk on every render, never cached.
